parent_reading.assessment: Original I106 claims receive independent I109 PASS WITHOUT REPAIRS and technical disposition. Parent read the complete I109 report and verification/diagnostic programs and checked the new P109/E109/N109 arguments in their stated scopes: residue separation forces the unique path and baselines; specialization has the correct rank direction; local degree and occupation sectors give disjoint tensor rank accounting; homogeneous Jordan chains have nondecreasing evaluated weights; occupation tails and coefficient normalization pay the uniform characteristic-two bound. No issue requiring repair found in these new technical arguments. This parent check is separate from the exact finite diagnostics and is not an independent child-review gate, human review, formal certification or substantiality acceptance. No claim that the degeneration upper bound controls full IMM rank. The all-prime target remains unproved/unrefuted; the tested construction branch is parked. Eight substantial findings remain accepted.
proof_checks: P109 active residues force the V monomial; U residues force its unique selected completion; baseline equality then makes one actual identity minor, including L=2. Ordinary diagonal products are 1 modulo primes dividing L.
SAD uses the negative-binomial atom at its mean, a mode comparison and Markov mass to lose only M_n=O(n^5); the uniform periodic loss follows by optimizing k log x-0.8 n x.

E109 variable scaling is diagonally equivalent on the generic fiber and specialization can only lower rank. Group degrees and each ballast exponent give independent source and target sectors; connector multiplication remains injective.

N109 maximal homogeneous Jordan chains split by the displayed graded equivariant projection. Terminal weights are maximal when beta>=alpha. Nilpotence four gives weighted rank fraction <=3/4; occupations >=4 cost at most 320/n in weighted mass, yielding 3/4+80/n per factor. The bound is only for g_t.
